title: OpenAI Expands Dots AI Agent Texting to Pro Users in Canada and Mexico
summary:
ChatGPT subscribers in Canada and Mexico who pay for the Pro tier gained the ability to message their personal AI agents on Oct. 30. The update enables these users to communicate with the company's "Dots" agents through iMessage and RCS, extending a feature that OpenAI first launched as a limited preview for US Pro users on Oct. 28.

The texting interface allows users to assign tasks via photos, voice notes, or text, with the agents capable of sending proactive status updates to the user's device. OpenAI stated that the agents maintain their context and plugins outside the ChatGPT app, though they do not have access to the user's other private messages. This follows the Oct. 28 launch of Dots for European Union business and enterprise clients, with consumer access in that region expected soon.

selectedTweets.text:
By popular request, you can now text your dot.

Give it a task to take off your plate or something to keep an eye on, using text, photos, or even voice notes. It will text you proactively with relevant updates.

Safe, secure texting via iMessage or RCS. You’re the only one who can text your dot, and your dot can only text you. Rolling out now as a preview for Pro users in the US.

selectedTweets.bestBit: This doesn’t give your dot or OpenAI access to your other text conversations.
selectedTweets.text:
To set it up, tap on your dot’s profile and select ‘Texting’.Your dot has the same context and plugins, wherever you reach it. This doesn’t give your dot or OpenAI access to your other text conversations.

AI is most useful when it works with tools you already use and shows up in places you already are, which is why we're excited to bring dots to texting. 

If you get access, please try it and share your feedback so we can make the experience even better for everyone.

OpenAI is rolling out texting for ChatGPT dots through iMessage and RCS.

Users can send tasks using text, photos or voice notes, and receive proactive messages when their dot has relevant updates. The agent carries over its existing context and connected plugins, so work can continue outside the ChatGPT app.

Setup is available under Texting in the dot’s profile. The feature is launching as a limited preview for Pro users in the US.
